title: Microsoft Places: availability in the GCC cloud
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, control calls and licensing statements are supported, and the planned GCC release is distinguished from general Places documentation. Two minor qualifications should acknowledge Microsoft's conflicting guidance on group scoping and Single Space licences for rooms.
